ruling.recommended_action: Reject the rider's refund request for T-2016; confirm the fixed quoted fare of SGD 34.38 stands. Fraud checks on GPS spacing not performed in this pass; no detour found, so no driver account action.

rejected_claims.reason: RydeX is a fixed-quote service; the fare does not vary with distance (§0; FARE-1). The quoted/actual route is 16.587 km matching the 16.587 km estimate, and tracing the GPS trace against the quoted polyline shows no off-route segment adding mileage, so no RD-2 refund basis exists.
